why: Q-Learning Lab is a named, adoptable browser-based instructional software tool rather than a general instructional element.
name: Q-Learning Lab
product_description: Q-Learning Lab is a single-file, offline bilingual browser tool made by Jueng for teaching introductory tabular Q-learning through an interactive gridworld, Bellman-update visualizations, transition logs, and CSV export.

why: This is a named, domain-specific competency framework for nursing education and practice evaluation, not a reusable instructional method or activity.
name: Ranked Q-set of 72 nursing competencies for family-centred care in hospitals
product_description: A literature-derived and professionally Q-sorted framework of 72 family-centred-care competencies for guiding education and evaluating hospital nurses, developed by Hengeveld et al.
